cards.name: Fireball
cards.description:
Retain.
Deal 14 damage to ALL enemies.
When Retained, increase this card's damage by 7 this combat.

cards.name: Shifting Form
cards.description: Play Demon Form, (+,) Serpent Form, (+,) Void Form, (+,) Reaper Form, (+,) or Echo Form (+) at random.

relics.name: Air Quality
relics.description: Whenever you would deal 9 or less unblocked attack damage, increase it to 10.
relics.flavorText: "That tingling sensation in the air, that's a sure sign that victory's at hand!"

relics.name: Blood Spree
relics.description: Upon pickup, obtain Charon's Obol. When you encounter the Merchant, gain 400 Gold and lose 4 Max HP.
relics.flavorText: "A sacrifice in blood is fully paid, and we are squared away."

relics.name: Bottomless Drink
relics.description: At the start of each combat, shuffle 5 random Power cards into your Draw Pile. They're free to play this combat.
relics.flavorText: "Enjoying that one, yeah? Well we've got plenty more, just let me know!"

relics.name: Bounce Back
relics.description: Start each combat with 5 Regen.
relics.flavorText: "I mean really, what's to fear from Titans, are they gonna rip me up limb from limb? Well I can't die man, I'll just put myself together ... and then have another drink!"

relics.name: Brilliant Riposte
relics.description: Fully blocked attack damage is reflected to your attacker.
relics.flavorText: "Foolish mistake ...!"

relics.name: Broken Resolve
relics.description: Weak effectiveness is doubled, up to a maximum of 50%.
relics.flavorText: "Try as I might, I just can't help but feel the sting of being spurned. And I don't like it, not a little bit. So now I have to sting you back!"

relics.name: Bronze Skin
relics.description: You take 20% less damage from enemy attacks.
relics.flavorText: "You fight as though you're unencumbered, but I know the surface weighs on you."

relics.name: Buried Treasure
relics.description: Whenever you gain Gold, gain 50% more. Whenever you heal, heal 50% more. Upon pickup, gain 100 Gold and heal 10 HP.
relics.flavorText: "Such is the smuggler's life!"

relics.name: Cardio Gain
relics.description: Every 5 times you hit an enemy with an Attack, gain [E].
relics.flavorText: "We'll turn that flicker in your step into a roaring flame!"

relics.name: Charon's Obol
relics.description: Your next Question Mark room is guaranteed to be a Shop.
relics.flavorText: "Hrraauuggh, naaaauugggghh..."

relics.name: Controlled Burn
relics.description: You may Burn card rewards to Hestia. For each card burned, upgrade a random card in your Deck.
relics.flavorText: "Sacrifices sometimes must be made, dearie. So round them up and put them to the flame!"

relics.name: Death
relics.description: Upon pickup, gain 1 Death Defiance.
relics.flavorText: Some mortals would sense his soft approach, others taken by surprise.

relics.name: Defensive Posture
relics.description: The first time you would receive unblocked attack damage, prevent that damage and become immune to enemy damage until the start of your next turn.
relics.flavorText: "Hold fast, Cousin!"

relics.name: Different League
relics.description: You take 3 less damage from enemy attacks.
relics.flavorText: "We're just two lovely goddesses together having a night out!"

relics.name: Divine Dash
relics.description: Start each combat with 2 Dexterity. Every time you play 8 Skills, gain 1 Blur.
relics.flavorText: "Then make haste."

relics.name: Divine Intervention
relics.description: At the end of your 8th turn, instantly win the combat. In Boss combats, deal 100 damage to ALL enemies instead.
relics.flavorText: "For we do not fail; merely take the necessary time to succeed."

relics.name: Divine Protection
relics.description: Every 3 turns, gain 1 Buffer.
relics.flavorText: "You bear the Amulet I gave to you. May it protect you and strike fear into the hearts of your enemies, whenever I am not around to do the same."

relics.name: Divine Vengeance
relics.description: Whenever you are attacked, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.
relics.flavorText: "Who dares oppose my niece?"

relics.name: Divinity
relics.description: Every other combat, a random card in each card reward is Upgraded.
relics.flavorText: The privilege of godhood is bestowed at birth, save for the rarest cases, when it is earned.

relics.name: Double Strike
relics.description: Upon pickup, enchant ALL cards containing "Strike" in your Deck with Double.
relics.flavorText: "Become as lightning, Niece, and strike our enemies before they know what hit them!"

relics.name: Drunken Dash
relics.description: Choose 5 Skills in your Deck. Enchant them with Intoxicate 4.
relics.flavorText: "Now come, my friends, drink up, like there's no tomorrow!"

relics.name: Drunken Stupor
relics.description: Whenever you play a Power card, apply 8 Hangover to ALL enemies.
relics.flavorText: "So I say, can't we just, wait ... have I not already told this one before? You'll tell me if I did? Or if you don't remember, that's cool! Neither do I, haha. What were we on about?"

relics.name: Electric Overload
relics.description: Gain [E] at the start of each turn. At the end of your turn, take 4 damage for each unspent Energy.
relics.flavorText: "There is no limit to the wrath of Olympus. Best not invite it on yourself again."

relics.name: Eternity
relics.description: The first time each combat you play a card that costs [E][E] or more, ALL enemies lose 4 Strength this turn.
relics.flavorText: The inevitable cannot be prevented, though perhaps can be forestalled.

relics.name: Excellence
relics.description: Every 3 normal combats, your card rewards gain an additional Rare card.
relics.flavorText: Not even gods can live to their fullest purpose; yet mortals all must strive.

relics.name: Fire Away
relics.description: Whenever you hit an enemy with an Attack, gain 2 Block.
relics.flavorText: "Don't let the fire in your heart sputter out, all right?"

relics.name: Flame Flourish
relics.description: Whenever you play a Skill, gain 3 Vigor.
relics.flavorText: "Well now I reckon it's time to fan the flames a bit, isn't it then?"

relics.name: Flame Strike
relics.description: The first 3 Attacks you play from your Hand each combat are played an additional time.
relics.flavorText: "Eh, a right good burn like that deserves another. Only fair, don't you agree, hot stuff?"

relics.name: Flash Fry
relics.description: At the start of combat, gain 5 Favor. At the end of your turn, lose 1 Favor. When combat ends, gain 30 Gold per Favor. If you defeat an Elite with any Favor remaining, obtain an additional Relic reward.
relics.flavorText: "Some evening, mayhaps you'll settle down to a nice comfortable life, but ohh, not tonight!"

relics.name: Flood Gain
relics.description: The first time each turn you deal at least 10 Attack damage in a single hit, gain [E].
relics.flavorText: "The tide's come in!"

relics.name: Flutter Flourish
relics.description: Every 4th Skill you play from your Hand is free.
relics.flavorText: "The more distracted you can make them, the easier they are to kill!"

relics.name: Furnace Blast
relics.description: Whenever you apply a debuff to an enemy, they take 12 damage.
relics.flavorText: "Don't like what I see, down comes my hammer just like that!"

relics.name: Glamour Gain
relics.description: The first time each turn you apply a debuff to an enemy, gain [E].
relics.flavorText: "Why, you look positively stunning in all that silver light!"

relics.name: Glowing Coal
relics.description: At the start of each combat, add 1 Fireball into your Hand.
relics.flavorText: "Let's keep that everlasting flame alive and well, what say you, hot stuff?"

relics.name: Grand Caldera
relics.description: Every 3 turns, deal 24 damage and apply 1 Vulnerable and 1 Weak to ALL enemies.
relics.flavorText: "Was as close as I am liable to get to blowing up. Still working at it, mind!"

relics.name: Grievous Blow
relics.description: Every 3rd Attack you play deals double damage.
relics.flavorText: "I shall empower you to acts of greater violence than before."

relics.name: Grisly Gain
relics.description: Every 4th Attack you play from your Hand is free.
relics.flavorText: "Perhaps my blessing shall let you deliver death still more efficiently."

relics.name: Happy Haze
relics.description: At the start of your 3rd turn, gain 4 Strength, 3 Dexterity, and if you have Orb Slots, also 2 Focus.
relics.flavorText: "All right, come on now, I don't even want to know what's happening out there. What's really happening is here!"

relics.name: Healthy Rebound
relics.description: At the start of each Normal/Elite/Boss combat, heal 5/15/25 HP.
relics.flavorText: "Though don't despair! Your heart yet beats, doesn't it?"

relics.name: Heartbreak Strike
relics.description: Your Attacks deal 5% more damage for each Weak on the enemy and apply 1 Weak on every hit.
relics.flavorText: "At this rate, you'll end up breaking more hearts than me!"

relics.name: Heat Rush
relics.description: At the start of each turn, gain [E] and Exhaust 1 card from your Hand.
relics.flavorText: "All right, hot stuff! We're turning up the temperature to get things roaring, then!"

relics.name: Heaven Flourish
relics.description: The first 3 Skills you play from your Hand each combat are played an additional time.
relics.flavorText: "You witches have a natural spark in you, I know, but here! I've got another."

relics.name: Heaven Strike
relics.description: Whenever you deal unblocked attack damage to an enemy without Blitz, apply Blitz.
relics.flavorText: "My lightning bolt is yours!"

relics.name: Heavy Metal
relics.description: At the start of each turn, gain 4 Forge Armor and deal damage equal to your Forge Armor to a random enemy.
relics.flavorText: "I just had the strongest urge to bang on solid metal for a bit."

relics.name: High Surf
relics.description: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Dexterity. Whenever you play a Skill, gain 1 Dexterity this turn.
relics.flavorText: "Flow forth, my niece, and overwhelm all those who stand against us, would you there?"

relics.name: High Tolerance
relics.description: Gain [E] at the start of each turn. Start each combat with 5 Hangover.
relics.flavorText: "No use fighting the inevitable when you're thirsty, yeah?"

relics.name: Highly Flammable
relics.description: Whenever you apply a debuff to an enemy, apply 2 additional stacks.
relics.flavorText: "What say we add a little fuel to this fire we've got going, why don't we?"

relics.name: Hot Pot
relics.description: Whenever you would lose HP, lose 3 less.
relics.flavorText: "Play with fire and you get yourself burned! It’s just as simple as that unless I say otherwise."

relics.name: Hydraulic Might
relics.description: Your Attacks deal double damage on the first 2 turns of combat.
relics.flavorText: "My waves can slam into the land with massive force, especially when I give them a little push!"

relics.name: Ionic Gain
relics.description: Every 2nd turn, add 1 Aether Font into your Hand.
relics.flavorText: "I have something for you."

relics.name: Judgement
relics.description: At the start of each future Act, obtain 2 random Arcana Relics.
relics.flavorText: The Underworld King is to decide what shall become of each and every mortal life.

relics.name: King Tide
relics.description: At the start of each Normal/Elite/Boss combat, gain 1/3/5 Strength.
relics.flavorText: "A storm is brewing, Niece. Big one, this time, why, even bigger than the last! Prepare!"

relics.name: Martial Art
relics.description: Whenever a debuff is applied to you, gain 2 Strength.
relics.flavorText: "Push me around, I'm liable to push right back. And I push harder than you might expect..."

relics.name: Meat Grinder
relics.description: Whenever you play a card that costs [E][E] or more, deal 8 damage to ALL enemies twice.
relics.flavorText: "May you sow such destruction as to shake this mountain to its core, my kin."

relics.name: Mental Block
relics.description: Start each combat with 2 Artifact. Whenever your Artifact triggers, gain 6 Block.
relics.flavorText: "You hide your troubles well, Melinoë."

relics.name: Mutual Destruction
relics.description: Your Attacks deal 25%/50%/100% more damage, while your HP is at or below 75%/50%/25%.
relics.flavorText: "You're on the verge of yet another brush with death, I see, my hell-born kin. Do send some others down with you, would you?"

relics.name: Nervous Wreck
relics.description: Whenever you apply a debuff to an enemy, apply twice as much.
relics.flavorText: "Our emotions ran a little hot there, didn't they... I still can feel my heart racing, and if I'm not mistaken, yours might have been, too!"

relics.name: Night
relics.description: The 3rd Attack you play from your Hand each combat is played an additional time.
relics.flavorText: She sprang from Chaos, and formed much of the natural world, above the surface and below.

relics.name: Origination
relics.description: Your Attacks deal 40% more damage to enemies with at least 2 different Debuffs.
relics.flavorText: From the infinite void emerged all that exists, and back to that void it all may yet return.

relics.name: Persistence
relics.description: Start each Elite or Boss combat with an additional [E][E]. At the end of each Elite or Boss combat, gain 2 Max HP.
relics.flavorText: He stole from the gods the gift of fire, for mortals; thus he suffered, but grew strong.

relics.name: Personal Loan
relics.description: Upon pickup, give up all your Gold. After vanquishing the next Elite, gain 1250 Gold and obtain Charon's Obol.
relics.flavorText: "Hey look, mate, let's not talk about that sort of thing in here, let's just relax! No need to get all down about that stuff!"

relics.name: Phalanx Shot
relics.description: At the end of your turn, deal damage equal to 50% of your Block to ALL enemies.
relics.flavorText: "For Olympus!"

relics.name: Power Surge
relics.description: Whenever you end your turn with any unspent Energy, deal damage equal to 4 times the current turn number to ALL enemies.
relics.flavorText: "Do show our enemies a properly electrifying time for me, would you?"

relics.name: Premium Service
relics.description: Each combat, upgrade the first 10 unupgraded cards you draw.
relics.flavorText: "Reckon you're looking for another tune-up, no problem at all."

relics.name: Premium Vintage
relics.description: Whenever you use a potion, gain 5 Max HP. Upon pickup, fill all your empty potion slots with random potions.
relics.flavorText: "... So I would like to propose another toast. To feasting! Cheers!!"

relics.name: Profuse Bleeding
relics.description: At the start of each enemy's turn, it loses 8 HP for each unique debuff it has.
relics.flavorText: "Perhaps the dead you stand against have long forgotten the experience of anguish and despair. I trust that you shall soon remind them for me?"

relics.name: Proud Bearing
relics.description: Start each combat with 8 Plating.
relics.flavorText: "Be proud, Cousin! You have achieved a glorious result, for which we all are thankful."

relics.name: Rallying Cry
relics.description: At the end of each Elite combat, gain 1 Glory. Start each combat with 2 Strength and 2 Thorns for each 1 Glory.
relics.flavorText: "May all the death you bring become the stuff of legends told in fearful mortal whisperings around the world, my kin."

relics.name: Razor Shoals
relics.description: Choose 3 Attacks in your Deck. Enchant them with Splashing 5.
relics.flavorText: "Come, Niece, let us crash upon our enemies as great waves upon a shore!"

relics.name: Reckless Abandon
relics.description: Your Attacks randomly deal exactly 5, 11, or 55 as their final damage whenever they hit. (Probabilities are: 40%, 50%, 10%).
relics.flavorText: "So you know what I say? I say, Dad ... hah. I say Dad, what if I just don't want to? And he says, Then get out of my sight! So I say, Outta sight? All right! Hahahaha!"

relics.name: Renewed Faith
relics.description: At the start of your turn, if you have 25% HP or less, heal to full HP and gain 3 Strength and 3 Dexterity. Works once.
relics.flavorText: "Now let's get you back to proper fighting shape."

relics.name: Righteous Pike
relics.description: Every [E][E][E] you spend, deal 5 damage to a random enemy 3 times.
relics.flavorText: "And I wouldn't advise getting run through by my spear, yet at times it must be done."

relics.name: Sanguinary Savor
relics.description: You can now Pay Tribute at Rest Sites.
relics.flavorText: "Your sacrifice to me just now has moved me to forgiveness for the time; thus shall we call a truce."

relics.name: Sea Star
relics.description: Whenever you take a combat reward, there is a 40% chance for another reward of the same type to appear. Rewards created this way can also trigger this effect.
relics.flavorText: "The untold bounties of the sea are yours! Well, one of them, at least!"

relics.name: Second Wave
relics.description: Every 2nd turn, gain [E] and draw 1 additional card.
relics.flavorText: "High tide has come again, my niece! Which is my little way of saying, here we go!"

relics.name: Security System
relics.description: On the first 3 turns of combat, gain double Block from cards.
relics.flavorText: "Next I offer you protection, witchie? You'd be wise to take me up on it."

relics.name: Shameless Attitude
relics.description: Your Attacks deal 33.(3)% more damage. If you have 50% HP or more, your Attacks deal 66.(6)% more damage instead.
relics.flavorText: "Oh, gorgeous. If pride and vanity are truly weaknesses, then I'm about to let myself be very vulnerable with you here..."

relics.name: Shocking Loss
relics.description: Every 3 combats, you may remove a card from your Deck.
relics.flavorText: "This shall come as a shock!"

relics.name: Sisyphus' Aid
relics.description: At the start of each combat, Rolling Boulder is played for free.
relics.flavorText: "Bouldy says whatever we can do to help, we'll do it!"

relics.name: Slippery Slope
relics.description: Your Attacks apply 1 Froth on every hit.
relics.flavorText: "Come on, Niece, let's go batter down our enemies like ships within a storm!"

relics.name: Slow Cooker
relics.description: You can now Slow Cook at Rest Sites.
relics.flavorText: "I've been cooking up a little something special just for you, hot stuff!"

relics.name: Smithy Rush
relics.description: Whenever you play a Skill, gain 2 Forge Armor.
relics.flavorText: "Let's get to work!"

relics.name: Smolder Ring
relics.description: At the end of your turn, deal damage equal to 2 times the number of Attacks played this turn to ALL enemies.
relics.flavorText: "Everything's going to be covered in soot by the time we're through!"

relics.name: Spiritual Affirmation
relics.description: Upon pickup, gain 16 Max HP and 499 Gold.
relics.flavorText: "As long as you have love in your heart, you'll probably be fine!"

relics.name: Stabbing Rush
relics.description: At the start of your turn, draw 2 cards and Exhaust 2 cards from your Hand.
relics.flavorText: "There are so many types of death... and yet, the sudden, violent kind is unsurpassed, I think."

relics.name: Stalwart Stand
relics.description: Upon pickup and at the start of each future Act, gain 1 Death Defiance.
relics.flavorText: "Thank the Fates that you eluded Typhon's fury."

relics.name: Static Shock
relics.description: Whenever you deal unblocked attack damage to an enemy, deal 50% of that damage to a different random enemy. If there are no other enemies, deal it to the original target instead.
relics.flavorText: "Our enemies will soon be in for quite the shock, I think!"

relics.name: Storm Ring
relics.description: Gain [E] at the start of each turn. Whenever you play a card that targets a single enemy, you must target that enemy until it dies.
relics.flavorText: "A storm is coming..."

relics.name: Strength
relics.description: While your HP is at or below 50%, you have 2 additional Strength and 1 additional Dexterity.
relics.flavorText: The power to surpass the might of the gods is one that must always be held in check.

relics.name: Strong Drink
relics.description: Whenever you Rest at a Rest Site, heal fully and start the next combat with an additional 3 Strength.
relics.flavorText: "Drink! Drink! Drink! Drink! Drink! Drink! Drink! Hehe, yeah!"

relics.name: Sweet Nectar
relics.description: Whenever you Smith at a Rest Site, upgrade 4 other random cards.
relics.flavorText: "A little gift."

relics.name: Sweet Surrender
relics.description: Whenever you apply Weak, apply the same amount of Vulnerable and Charm.
relics.flavorText: "Between us goddesses, may you kill everybody standing in your way!"

relics.name: The Artificer
relics.description: The next 2 times you discard a Potion during combat, obtain an additional Relic reward.
relics.flavorText: Few can turn raw materials into works into work of extraordinary genius; none as can he.

relics.name: The Boatman
relics.description: The next Relic you buy in a shop is free.
relics.flavorText: Vast riches lie hidden in the realm of the dead; but only a modest fee is needed to get in.

relics.name: The Centaur
relics.description: Every 3 combats, gain 4 Max HP.
relics.flavorText: Many of the greatest heroes mortalkind has to offer have in common his patient instructions.

relics.name: The Champions
relics.description: The next 3 Relic rewards from Elites offer 2 Relics to choose from.
relics.flavorText: Once-mortal foes, they found each other once again in death, and were exalted in Elysium.

relics.name: The Enchantress
relics.description: For the next 2 combats, each card in Card Rewards gains a random Enchantment.
relics.flavorText: In mastering metamorphosis, she discovered that only the true nature of a thing cannot be changed.

relics.name: The Fates
relics.description: For the next 5 combats, you may reroll each card reward once.
relics.flavorText: Even the gods themselves are subject to the whims of the three weavers of destiny.

relics.name: The Furies
relics.description: Your Attacks deal 40% more damage to enemies that do not intend to attack.
relics.flavorText: In the deepest reaches of the Underworld, three are as feared as the god of the dead himself.

relics.name: The Huntress
relics.description: Cards that cost 0[E] deal 2 additional damage, and give 2 additional Block.
relics.flavorText: Through discipline and instinct comes sustaining skill both in shadow and the light of the moon.

relics.name: The Lovers
relics.description: At the start of each Elite or Boss combat, apply 1 Infatuated to ALL enemies.
relics.flavorText: Their music brought them together, and not even Death could keep them apart for long.

relics.name: The Messenger
relics.description: The first time each combat you play 3 Skills in a single turn, gain 1 Buffer.
relics.flavorText: With incomparable swiftness can he travel from the highest peaks to the lowest depths.

relics.name: The Moon
relics.description: At the start of your 3rd turn, gain [E] and draw 2 cards.
relics.flavorText: Even as she races across the fathomless sky, she bears witness to all.

relics.name: The Queen
relics.description: Every 3 normal combats, obtain an additional card reward from another character.
relics.flavorText: From Olympus she descends to reign in Underworld as the surface-land grows cold.

relics.name: The Sorceress
relics.description: The first time each combat you play a card that costs [E][E] or more, gain [E][E].
relics.flavorText: Left to her own devices, she learned to confront the world on her own terms.

relics.name: The Swift Runner
relics.description: You may ignore paths when traveling to and from Shops.
relics.flavorText: Those who attempted to confront the greatest of the Greeks merely met his spear.

relics.name: The Unseen
relics.description: Every 9[E] you spend, gain [E].
relics.flavorText: Upon their ancient oath, in shadow, they serve; and to shadow, they return.

relics.name: The Wayward Son
relics.description: At the end of each combat, heal 2 HP.
relics.flavorText: Even the Underworld itself struggled to contain him, such was his lust for life.

relics.name: Thunder Rush
relics.description: At the start of each combat, gain 3 Orb Slots. Upon pickup, enchant ALL your basic Defend cards with Thundercall.
relics.flavorText: "Behold my thunderbolts!"

relics.name: Tipsy Shot
relics.description: Whenever you use a potion, its effect is applied an additional time.
relics.flavorText: "... another round, you say? Well I don't see why not! Ah, haha!"

relics.name: Tough Gain
relics.description: At the start of each turn, gain [E] and lose 1 HP.
relics.flavorText: "So you took some hits along the way, so what? You're an extension of your weapon, witchie! And a decent one can take a lot of punishment."

relics.name: Trusty Shield
relics.description: Whenever you end your turn with any unspent Energy, gain 14 Block.
relics.flavorText: "You got a dangerous line of work, witchie. Though I can get you some protection here."

relics.name: Uncanny Fortitude
relics.description: Upon pickup, gain 3 Max HP for each Upgraded or Enchanted card in your Deck. Whenever a card in your Deck becomes Upgraded or Enchanted, or such a card is added to your Deck, gain 3 Max HP.
relics.flavorText: "You still alive, witchie? Here, this ought to keep it that way."

relics.name: Vicious Flourish
relics.description: Whenever you play a Skill card, apply 4 Wounds to a random enemy.
relics.flavorText: "This world has a limitless capacity for pain; and so, it truly is no inconvenience to help you to bring out a little more."

relics.name: Vicious Strike
relics.description: Upon pickup, choose 5 Attacks in your Deck. Enchant them with Wounding.
relics.flavorText: "I'd like to offer you a choice amongst my most exquisite tools which inflict suffering."

relics.name: Visceral Impact
relics.description: At the start of each turn, lose 1 HP. At the end of your first turn, your Form card is played for free.
relics.flavorText: "So much letting of blood, so much of it, your own. Let's see to keeping you alive and in the fight a while longer, then."

relics.name: Volcanic Flourish
relics.description: At the start of your turn, add a random Skill into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.
relics.flavorText: "Just clanking away as always, though let's do some clanking now on your behalf."

relics.name: Volcanic Strike
relics.description: The first Attack you play each turn applies Blast equal to the damage dealt.
relics.flavorText: "You want to see my handiwork, then fine! Might get a wee bit noisy, though."

relics.name: Water Fitness
relics.description: Upon pickup, gain 2 Max HP for each relic you have, including this one. Whenever you obtain a relic, gain 2 Max HP.
relics.flavorText: "Arise, my niece! As would a fierce sea-creature of some sort! One blessed by me!"

relics.name: Wave Flourish
relics.description: The first time each turn you draw 2 cards during your turn, gain [E].
relics.flavorText: "The tides are turning, can't you feel it, Niece? I can, of course, but surely you can, too!"

relics.name: Wave Strike
relics.description: The 3rd Attack you play from your Hand each turn is played an additional time.
relics.flavorText: "Here comes the wave!"

relics.name: Worry Free
relics.description: Gain a random amount of Max HP between 40 to 60. Future healing effects are randomized between 50% and 125% effectiveness.
relics.flavorText: "Don't anybody worry about a thing, we've got it all under control!"

enchantments.name: Thundercall
enchantments.description: Increases Block gained from this card by 3. On play, Channel 1 Lightning.

enchantments.name: Splashing
enchantments.description: Apply N Riptide on every hit.

enchantments.name: Intoxicate
enchantments.description: Apply N Hangover to ALL enemies.

enchantments.name: Wounding
enchantments.description: Apply Wounds equal to half the damage dealt on every hit.

keywords.name: Death Defiance
keywords.description: When your HP would be reduced to 0, lose 1 Death Defiance and heal to 40% of your Max HP instead.

keywords.name: Pay Tribute
keywords.description: Lose {MaxHpLoss} Max HP to obtain {RelicsToObtain} relic, Upgrade {CardsToUpgrade} card, remove {CardsToRemove} card, and procure {PotionsToProcure} potion.

keywords.name: Slow Cook
keywords.description: Remove {CardsToRemove} {CardsToRemove:plural:card|cards} from your Deck and gain {StrengthToGain} Strength at the start of each combat.

keywords.name: Blitz
keywords.description: After this creature takes 15 more unblocked attack damage, it takes 8 damage, and the damage of all future Blitz triggers on this creature is increased by 4.

keywords.name: Heaven Struck
keywords.description: This creature takes more damage from Blitz.

keywords.name: Marked by Storm Ring
keywords.description: You must target this creature until it dies.

keywords.name: Froth
keywords.description: Whenever this creature obtains 3 stacks, it takes 10 damage and loses 2 Strength this turn.

keywords.name: High Surf
keywords.description: Gain Dexterity until the end of this turn.

keywords.name: Riptide
keywords.description: Creatures with Riptide take damage at the start of their turn.

keywords.name: Froth
keywords.description: Lose Strength until the end of this turn.

keywords.name: Blast
keywords.description: Blasted creatures take damage at the start of their turn. Each turn, Blast is reduced by half.

keywords.name: Forge Armor
keywords.description: A different version of Block that is not lost at the start of your turn. Triggers after your regular Block, before Osty.

keywords.name: Eternity
keywords.description: Lose Strength until the end of this turn.

keywords.name: Infatuated
keywords.description: This creature's next Attack deals 0 damage.

keywords.name: Hangover
keywords.description: Hungover creatures take damage at the end of their turn. Each turn, Hangover is reduced by 1.

keywords.name: Wounds
keywords.description: Your next Attack that deals damage to the Wounded creature deals additional damage.

keywords.name: Charm
keywords.description: Whenever this creature obtains 6 stacks, it's stunned.

mods.name: Hades Ancients
mods.description: This mod adds Olympian Gods from the hit game Hades 2 as new Ancients.
